notes: eucalyptol and 1,8-cineole are one chemical identity; do not count them as different molecules.
Generic ionone is not an identity-specific allowlist entry; distinguish alpha and beta ionones. FDA CAS values are recorded as reported, and may differ by stereoisomer specificity.
